summary: Israel struck Qatar targeting Hamas leadership in a landmark escalation, while Iran's nuclear case was referred to the UN Security Council by the IAEA board. Multiple explosions were reported across Hormozgan Province including Jask, Qeshm, and Sirik, alongside strikes on King Fahd Air Base in Saudi Arabia. The IRGC demanded the US cease hostilities and open the Strait of Hormuz, while Netanyahu declared from Mount Hermon that defeating the Iranian regime remains the primary objective.
key_points: Israel conducted an airstrike on Qatar targeting senior Hamas leaders, with images of the attack on the Palestinian enclave's capital publicly released for the first time (Source: @SharghDaily/182836).

The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear non-proliferation case to the UN Security Council after 20 years, following Iran's failure to meet commitments, potentially paving the way for renewed international sanctions (Source: @VahidOnline/78302).

Multiple explosions were reported in Hormozgan Province including Jask, Qeshm, and Sirik, with gunshots heard near the Strait of Hormuz, indicating active strikes on Iranian territory (Source: @shin_persian/9645).

Saudi Arabia announced that Houthi forces attacked a series of southern cities using ballistic missiles and drones, while emergency alerts were activated in Khamis Mushait and Bahah (Source: @asafroz/53272).
Explosions were reported at King Fahd Air Base in Saudi Arabia, and Saudi civil defense issued emergency alerts across multiple regions amid escalating regional hostilities (Source: @PressTV/206146).

The IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch site in Gaza used by Hamas and PIJ, seizing rockets, Kalaashnikovs, and additional combat equipment (Source: @New_security8200/203714).

IRGC spokesperson Hussein Habibi demanded the US halt the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, end the Yemen siege, release $24 billion in frozen Iranian assets, and cease interference in Iran's nuclear and missile programs (Source: @VahidOnline/78299).

sections.executive_summary: Israel's airstrike on Qatar targeting Hamas leadership marks a dramatic expansion of the conflict beyond traditional theaters. Simultaneously, Iran faces mounting pressure as the IAEA referred its nuclear case to the UN Security Council, and multiple explosions struck Hormozgan Province. The IRGC has issued explicit demands for a ceasefire while Netanyahu declared from Mount Hermon that defeating the Iranian regime remains the primary war objective.
iran: The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear case to the UN Security Council after 20 years, citing violations of non-proliferation commitments, following a June 12 board resolution listing Iran's non-compliance (Source: @VahidOnline/78302).

Multiple explosions struck Hormozgan Province including Jask at 1544Z, Qeshm, and Sirik, with gunshots reported near the Strait of Hormuz, indicating active military strikes on Iranian territory (Source: @shin_persian/9645).

IRGC spokesperson Hussein Habibi demanded the US halt the war completely, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, end the Yemen siege, release $24 billion in frozen Iranian assets, and stop interference in nuclear and missile programs (Source: @VahidOnline/78299).

The IRGC claimed to have targeted two US Navy destroyers in the Middle East, a claim disputed by US Central Command, while US forces reportedly destroyed 10 Iranian tankers constituting part of a multi-billion-dollar shadow fleet (Source: @VahidOnline/78294).

Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson criticized the new IAEA resolution as contradictory, noting it fails to address the agency's lack of access caused by US and Israeli aggression, and that roughly one-third of member states voted against or abstained (Source: @SharghDaily/182831).

The Iranian rial reached 233,000 tomans per dollar due to compounded sanctions and the naval blockade halting oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz, causing unprecedented inflation (Source: @VahidOnline/78299).

Trump stated at the Republican convention that the Iran war would end immediately after the midterm elections, while also threatening Iran with devastating force if they attempt to deceive the US regarding activity at Mount Musheir (Source: @SharghDaily/182834).
Mossad estimates the Iranian regime will fall, according to Israeli intelligence assessments reported publicly (Source: @amitsegal/64811).
israel: Israel conducted an airstrike on Qatar targeting senior Hamas leaders, with images of the strike on the Palestinian enclave's capital released publicly for the first time (Source: @SharghDaily/182836).

Netanyahu appeared at Mount Hermon overlooking Syrian and Lebanese border areas, declaring that the primary objective of Israel's military campaigns is defeating and fully weakening the Iranian regime (Source: @VahidOnline/78300).

The IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch site in Gaza used by Hamas and PIJ, seizing rockets, Kalaashnikovs, and additional combat equipment (Source: @New_security8200/203714).
IDF spokesperson stated that alerts on hostile aircraft intrusion in northern Israel were false detections, following multiple alerts activated earlier in the day (Source: @New_security8200/203745).

IDF arrested three Palestinian officers near Beituniya in Area C for blocking a road, injuring an Israeli citizen, and using aggressive force beyond their authority, described as a severe institutional deviation (Source: @idf_telegram/25098).

Several casualties were reported in Gaza from an IDF airstrike targeting a motorcycle, and a separate strike hit a building in Gaza City's Shati camp following a military warning (Source: @New_security8200/203721).
Israel requested Saudi Arabia and Pakistan to join the conflict and attack Houthi rebels in Yemen, according to reports from regional intelligence sources (Source: @kianmeli1/91729).

Several casualties were reported in Gaza from an IDF airstrike targeting a motorcycle in the city, according to local security sources (Source: @New_security8200/203721).
Palestinian media reported an Israeli strike on a building in Gaza City's Shati camp following a military warning, with no immediate IDF comment (Source: @manniefabian/59132).
IDF arrested three Palestinian officers near Beituniya in Area C for blocking a road, injuring an Israeli citizen, and using aggressive force beyond their authority (Source: @idf_telegram/25098).

IDF forces in the Southern Command are deployed across the Gaza Strip in accordance with the agreement and will continue operations to eliminate terrorist capabilities and prevent rearmament (Source: @New_security8200/203714).
lebanon: Israeli warplanes launched multiple airstrikes on the town of Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon, according to Press TV reporting (Source: @presstv/206154).

Lebanese media reported one person killed in an Israeli strike on a motorcycle on a road between the towns of Harouf and Zebdin in southern Lebanon, with no immediate IDF comment (Source: @manniefabian/59131).
Artillery shelling was reported targeting the town of Al-Dabsha, with direct mapping of strikes circulating on social media (Source: @redlinkleb/41943).

Netanyahu referenced Israeli military presence in border areas of Lebanon and Syria from Mount Hermon, stating no terrorist group would be allowed to station itself on Israel's borders (Source: @VahidOnline/78300).
Israel ranks Lebanon as the secondary theater of operations after Iran, with the potential for rapid escalation to full-scale fighting across multiple fronts (Source: @New_security8200/203728).
syria_iraq: A Panama-flagged tanker carrying Iraqi fuel oil was struck by a drone in Iraqi territorial waters on Wednesday, with port officials confirming the fire was extinguished and no casualties reported (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6972).

Netanyahu referenced Israeli military operations and presence in Syrian border areas from Mount Hermon, declaring that no terrorist group would be permitted to establish itself on Israel's borders (Source: @VahidOnline/78300).
Artillery shelling was reported targeting the town of Al-Dabsha in the broader Syria-Lebanon border region, with direct mapping of strikes circulating on social media (Source: @redlinkleb/41943).

Israel ranks Iran as the primary theater of operations, with Lebanon secondary and Yemen in the background, noting that while no front is currently in active full-scale combat, rapid multi-front escalation is possible (Source: @New_security8200/203728).
gulf_states: Saudi Arabia announced that Houthi forces attacked a series of cities in the south of the Kingdom using ballistic missiles and drones, according to Saudi official statements (Source: @asafroz/53272).
Several explosions were reported at King Fahd Air Base in Saudi Arabia, according to Press TV citing Reuters sources (Source: @PressTV/206146).
Saudi civil defense activated emergency alerts in the Khamis Mushait and Bahah regions of the country, according to official Saudi civil defense announcements (Source: @N12chat/226032).
Israel reportedly requested Saudi Arabia and Pakistan to join the conflict and attack Houthi rebels in Yemen, according to regional intelligence reports (Source: @kianmeli1/91729).

Trump addressed the Iranian people at the Republican convention, stating their time of freedom is near and that once US operations conclude, the Iranian people will take control of their own government (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80630).
key_developments: Israel struck Qatar targeting senior Hamas leaders, marking a dramatic expansion of the conflict into the Gulf, with images of the airstrike on the Palestinian enclave's capital released publicly for the first time (Source: @SharghDaily/182836).

The IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear non-proliferation case to the UN Security Council after 20 years, potentially paving the way for renewed international sanctions against Tehran (Source: @VahidOnline/78302).

Multiple explosions struck Hormozgan Province including Jask, Qeshm, and Sirik, with gunshots heard near the Strait of Hormuz, indicating active military strikes on Iranian territory (Source: @shin_persian/9645).

Saudi Arabia reported Houthi attacks on southern cities using ballistic missiles and drones, while emergency alerts were activated in Khamis Mushait and Bahah, and explosions were heard at King Fahd Air Base (Source: @asafroz/53272).

The IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch site in Gaza used by Hamas and PIJ, seizing rockets, Kalaashnikovs, and additional combat equipment (Source: @New_security8200/203714).

IRGC spokesperson demanded the US halt the war, reopen the Strait of Hormuz, end the Yemen siege, release $24 billion in frozen assets, and cease interference in Iran's nuclear and missile programs (Source: @VahidOnline/78299).

Netanyahu declared from Mount Hermon that defeating and fully weakening the Iranian regime is the primary objective of Israel's military campaigns, while referencing Israeli military presence across Syrian and Lebanese borders (Source: @VahidOnline/78300).
sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has expanded to an unprecedented geographic scale, with Israel striking Qatar and conducting strikes across Lebanon, Gaza, and Syria while Iran faces direct strikes in Hormozgan Province. The IRGC's demand for a ceasefire combined with its threat of proportional escalation ('if the enemy hits two of our targets, we respond with 20') suggests the regime is under severe pressure but retains significant retaliatory capability. The IAEA referral to the UNSC and the naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz have created compounding economic and diplomatic pressure on Iran, with the rial collapsing to 233,000 tomans per dollar. The potential for multi-front escalation remains high, as Israel itself acknowledges Iran is the primary theater with Lebanon secondary and Yemen in the background.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia is under direct pressure from Houthi ballistic missile and drone attacks on southern cities while simultaneously being courted by Israel to join the conflict against the Houthis in Yemen. The US has reportedly destroyed 10 Iranian tankers and is conducting strikes on Iranian territory, while Trump has publicly stated the Iran war will end after the midterm elections. Iran's IRGC has issued explicit ceasefire demands including reopening the Strait of Hormuz and releasing $24 billion in frozen assets, while simultaneously threatening expanded retaliation. The IAEA's referral of Iran's nuclear case to the UNSC signals growing international isolation for Tehran, with roughly one-third of member states opposing or abstaining from the resolution.
sections.intelligence_notes: Mossad assesses that the Iranian regime will fall, according to publicly reported Israeli intelligence estimates. The IRGC has claimed to have targeted US Navy destroyers in the Middle East, a claim disputed by US Central Command, indicating information warfare and propaganda efforts on both sides. The naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has halted Iranian oil exports and caused unprecedented inflation, while the IRGC's shadow fleet of tankers has been significantly degraded. Netanyahu's appearance at Mount Hermon overlooking Syrian and Lebanese border areas signals continued focus on the Iran-led axis, while the IDF's destruction of Hamas and PIJ weapons infrastructure in Gaza demonstrates ongoing counterterrorism operations alongside the broader regional campaign.
